courses.title: Learn Markdown from Scratch
courses.subtitle: Format text for the web with plain characters
courses.description: The formatting language of README files, notes, and chat. Learn headings, lists, links, and code blocks by writing them yourself.

courses.title: Learn Computer Networking from Scratch
courses.subtitle: How the internet actually delivers things
courses.description: LANs and WANs, IP addresses and DNS, TCP and UDP, HTTP and HTTPS, and the boxes in your home that move the bits. No jargon without a translation.

courses.title: Basics of Neuroscience
courses.subtitle: How three pounds of cells think, feel, and remember
courses.description: Neurons and glia, action potentials, brain regions, neurotransmitters, and how learning physically rewires the brain. Plain language, real facts.

courses.title: Basics of Computer Security
courses.subtitle: How to stay safe without the paranoia
courses.description: Passwords that hold, phishing you can spot, malware by name, and the everyday habits — updates, 2FA, backups — that keep the bad guys out. No fear, just fundamentals.

courses.title: Learn SQL from Scratch
courses.subtitle: Ask questions, get answers, from a real database in your browser
courses.description: SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, counting, and JOINs, run against a small library database built right into the page. Every answer is checked against real results.
